headings: INSTRUCTIONS FOR A BETTER LIFE ON THE HAVENS

sections.heading: RECON (NOT IN PROLOGUE)
sections.text:
When you Recon, you are exploring some of the lost world in an attempt to learn what happened and how it can help you with your objectives.

Each location where you can Recon shows you what you must discard in order to recon from there. In most cases you need to recon from a supply center. Read each recon description to see what you need:

• Unless otherwise stated, there must be a supply center [supply center icon] in that city.
• You need to discard City cards from your hand matching those on the route leaving the city.
• If the cards on the route have an * symbol (e.g., [blue card icon with *]), the cards can be of any cities—only the color matters.
Example:
Recon with any 3 blue cards from a supply center here to open Package 1.
[three blue squares, each with a white *]
• If the cards have letters on them (e.g., [black square with A]), then each card discarded of that color must be a unique city.
Example:
Recon with 4 unique black cards from a supply center here to open Package 2.
[four black squares labeled A B C D]
• When you successfully do the Recon action, open the package number as shown on the route.

sections.heading: FREE ACTIONS
sections.text: These actions must be taken during the “Do Actions” step but do not count toward your 4 actions for the turn. Free actions cannot be used to interrupt other actions. For example, you cannot do the Pick Up Supplies action on the haven in the Mediterranean while using the Sail action to get from London to Cairo.

sections.heading: PICK UP SUPPLIES
sections.text: Take as many Supply cubes as you like from your location and put them onto your Character card.

sections.heading: TRANSFER SUPPLIES
sections.text:
Give as many Supply cubes as you like to a player in your location or take as many Supply cubes as you like from that player (with their permission).

RULE STICKER I

It is Anna’s turn and she wishes to play her Produce Supplies card and deliver some supplies. Since she is already in a haven, she can set her plan in motion right away.

1. She first plays a Produce Supplies card for its Local Production ability at the empty haven where she is. Anna takes 3 Supply cubes from the stockpile (the haven’s population limit) and fills her haven with them. (She does not check a box on the card since she played it for Local Production.)

Free. She picks up all 3 cubes (she could have picked up fewer cubes) with the Pick Up Supplies free action and puts them onto her Character card.

2. Anna does the Drive/Ferry action to move her pawn to Lagos.

3. She does the Deliver Supplies action there and puts 2 cubes on Lagos (she could have delivered a different number of cubes instead).

4. Then she does the Sail action, discarding the London card from her hand to move to London.

Free. Anna transfers supplies for free to Adele, who is also in London, with the Transfer Supplies free action.
